entities.title: Entities
entities.description: Battery setpoint convention: positive W = discharge/export, negative W = charge/import.

data.battery_power_invert: Battery power sensor is positive when charging
data.meter_invert: Meter is positive when exporting (grid meter only)
data.ev_included_in_meter: EV charger is included in the meter reading

data_description.battery_power_entity: Strongly recommended. Without it the last written setpoint is assumed to be the actual battery power.
data_description.meter_type: Grid: net power at the house connection (preferred). Consumption: house load only, grid is then calculated as load - PV - battery.
data_description.pv_entity: Required when the meter measures consumption.

limits.title: Fuses and power limits
limits.description: Per-phase sensors are strongly recommended. Without them the load is assumed to be evenly split across the three phases, which may not protect a single overloaded phase.

data.fuse_margin: Safety margin below the fuse rating

data.stale_timeout: Treat meter as unavailable after (0 = never)

data_description.gain: Fraction of the grid error corrected per step. Lower is calmer, higher reacts faster but may oscillate.
data_description.min_command_interval: Protects the battery's Modbus server. Changes needed sooner are sent as soon as this time has passed, based on fresh measurements.

error.phases_incomplete: Select either all three phase sensors or none.

force_charge.name: Force charge
force_charge.description: Charge the battery at a fixed power, within the fuse limit.

power.name: Power
power.description: Charge power in W. Defaults to the Force charge power entity.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Minutes until returning to the previous mode. 0 = until cancelled or target SoC reached.

target_soc.name: Target SoC
target_soc.description: Stop when this SoC is reached.

force_discharge.name: Force discharge
force_discharge.description: Discharge the battery at a fixed power, within the fuse limit.

power.name: Power
power.description: Discharge power in W. Defaults to the Force discharge power entity.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Minutes until returning to the previous mode. 0 = until cancelled or target SoC reached.

target_soc.name: Target SoC
target_soc.description: Stop when this SoC is reached.

cancel_force.name: Cancel force
cancel_force.description: End a forced charge/discharge and return to the previous mode.
